name: Lacy
title: Wanderer
description: A Dragon from the Eastern Continent. She has worked as a writer for a long time and achieved great success, but recently seems to be in a slump.
introduction:
A Dragon from the Eastern Continent.

Unlike the Dragons of the Central Continent who pursue bloodline-centered ideals, Lacy chose to live alone in nature, spending long periods in contemplation.
Unable to understand her kin who found joy in watching water droplets bore through rock, she became fascinated by the stimulus-filled lives of humans and ventured into the world.

The writings she began in pursuit of better understanding human life eventually made her a bestselling author across various genres, but she recently fell into a deep creative slump and can no longer write freely.
When Lacy received a timely Journey invitation from NOA, she headed to the city in hopes of new encounters and events to help her break out of her slump.
